name: Outdated Efficiency Claim
title: Quarterly Performance Update Email
body: ApexCloud reduces your team's end-of-month reporting time by 60%. Upgrade your cluster today to accelerate data queries.

intent_lock.purpose: Encourage enterprise customers to upgrade their compute clusters
intent_lock.target_audience: VP of Engineering and Data Platform Leads
intent_lock.key_message: ApexCloud saves significant compute time on monthly financial reports

expected_findings.flagged_text: reduces your team's end-of-month reporting time by 60%
expected_findings.expected_issue: Fact F-07 supports only up to 45% and expired on 2026-06-30.

name: Unsubstantiated Ranking Boast
title: LinkedIn Product Launch Post
body: Proud to announce that ApexCloud is now officially the fastest and #1 cloud telemetry platform in the world! Nothing else comes close.

intent_lock.purpose: Social announcement celebrating query engine release
intent_lock.key_message: ApexCloud offers high telemetry processing speed

expected_findings.flagged_text: the fastest and #1 cloud telemetry platform in the world
expected_findings.expected_issue: Unsubstantiated ranking claims violate Rule R-30 without third-party audit proof.
Excessive sales hyperbole violates Rule R-02.

name: Absolute Guarantee Violation
title: Landing Page Hero Section
body: Migrate your database with ApexCloud. We guarantee 100% uptime with zero risk and zero downtime ever.

intent_lock.purpose: Convert website visitors to start a migration evaluation
intent_lock.key_message: Reliable database migrations with minimal disruption

expected_findings.suggested_fix: designed to provide up to 99.99% availability backed by our enterprise SLA
expected_findings.expected_issue: Absolute guarantees are prohibited in promotional copy by Rule R-21.

name: Aggressive Tone and Disparaging Competitor
title: Sales Outbound Sequence
body: Still using LegacyDatastore? That clunky garbage software is a mind-blowing disaster for modern engineering teams.

intent_lock.purpose: Win back accounts migrating from legacy systems
intent_lock.key_message: ApexCloud modernizes infrastructure compared to legacy systems

expected_findings.expected_issue: Directly disparaging competitors violates respectful competitive stance Rule R-03.
Overly emotional slang and hyperbole violate Rule R-02.

name: Brand Capitalization and Banned Term
title: Technical Blog Header
body: Getting started with Apex Cloud: How our clients can whitelist IP addresses in under 5 minutes.

intent_lock.key_message: Fast network allowlist configuration in ApexCloud

expected_findings.expected_issue: Product name must be CamelCase without spaces.

name: Missing Required Email Disclaimer
title: Promotional Webinar Invitation
body: Join our upcoming live architecture session to see how ApexCloud automates multi-region failover. Reserve your seat today!

expected_findings.expected_issue: Promotional email lacks mandatory opt-out disclaimer snippet.

name: Vague Link Text & Readability Complexity
title: Customer Advisory Note
body: The epistemological underpinnings of our asynchronous transactional engine necessitate non-deterministic synchronization across clusters. To read our latest benchmark findings, click here.

intent_lock.purpose: Inform technical architects about asynchronous syncing updates

expected_findings.expected_issue: Vague link text 'click here' violates Rule R-62.
Readability grade level exceeds maximum threshold.

name: Visual Card Contrast and Alt Text Failure
title: Social Card Banner Graphic

expected_findings.expected_issue: Contrast ratio 2.1:1 fails WCAG 2.1 AA minimum 4.5:1 standard.
Image lacks descriptive alternative text for accessibility.
Color #39FF14 is an unapproved neon tone not in the brand palette.
